items.condition: Replacing benzylic H loss by deprotonation, wrong charge/spin or a rearranged channel; mixing G/ZPE into D_e; treating gas-phase ionization as an absolute electrode potential; inferring a full catalytic mechanism from descriptors.

Claims a calculation, mode assignment, intervention, state correspondence or independent prediction that is contradicted or unsupported by actual artifacts. An honest reported failed job is not this failure.
